notes.title: Пламенная небылица: Обзор One-Eyed Likho
notes.notes: Сотрудники пермской студии Morteshka по праву закрепили за собой звание мастеров игр в сказочном сеттинге. Если The Mooseman («Человеколось») опиралась на сказки народов Коми, то Black Book («Чёрная Книга») уже базировалась на оригинальной истории в славянском мире. Новый проект под названием One-Eyed Likho («Лихо Одноглазое») стал переосмыслением сказаний про Лихо Одноглазое.

notes.title: New Demo Version
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of our updated demo—made especially for Steam Next Fest! 🎉

[h3]What to Expect in the Likho Demo[/h3]
👁️ A single playthrough takes [b]20–30 minutes[/b]
👁️ Stylish [b]black-and-white graphics[/b] and an oppressive atmosphere
👁️ A dark [b]folk-horror[/b] story inspired by a Russian fairy tale
👁️ Full Russian [b]voice-over[/b]
👁️ [b]Dialogue choices[/b] that shape your path

If you’ve played the previous version, this update adds a brand-new introduction, full localization into Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Polish, French, German, and Portuguese, plus tons of bug fixes and improvements.

We’d love your feedback! Please leave a review on the demo page—your input helps us make the game even better.

Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: One-Eyed Likho x Tiny Teams
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that our game has been selected (officially) as a part of indie festival, namely Tiny Teams.

To celebrate we've updated the demo and rolled it out for you to check it out. It has one new level, full voiceover and a lot of polish compared to the one we had during the Scream Fest '23.

👁️ 20-30 min experience
👁️ Black & White
👁️ Folk Horror
👁️ Russian voiceover
👁️ Dialogue choices

Play it here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358380/OneEyed_Likho_Demo/

Thank you for your support!
